name: Blackstone Inc.
price_source: StockAnalysis.com (close Jun 22, 2026, $123.26); cross-checked Google Finance/companiesmarketcap (~$123-124) and CNBC quote

conservador.note: Owner-earnings (DE/sh) base $6.10; Phase1 CAGR 6%, Phase2 4%, g 2.5%. Private-credit redemption drag (BCRED $82B outflows), slower realizations and fundraising in a higher-for-longer rate regime; decelerating but NOT collapsing franchise.

base.note: Phase1 CAGR 10%, Phase2 6%, g 3.0%. Double-digit FRE/DE growth normalizes to high-single-digit; record AUM $1.30T, strong inflows ($68.5B Q1) and perpetual-capital base sustain compounding through the cycle.

optimista.note: Phase1 CAGR 14%, Phase2 8%, g 3.0%. Re-acceleration on secular flows into infra/AI/energy and private credit; private-wealth (BCRED/perpetual) engine re-rates as redemption scare proves technical.

owner_fcf_base: Distributable Earnings (DE) used as owner-earnings proxy (cleaner than GAAP FCF for an alt-manager: nets non-cash items, captures fee + realized performance economics). FY2025 DE $7.1B / $5.57 per sh; FY2026E DE ~$6.10-6.30 per sh (~$7.6B). DCF base $6.10/sh = forward DE/sh with a small residual cushion for ongoing equity-comp dilution (FY2025 equity-based comp $1,445M, +24% YoY, ~10% of revenue / ~32% of GAAP FCF — flagged). Reported FCF $4.55B less 100% SBC ($1.445B) = ~$3.1B owner-FCF would understate the franchise's true cash economics, hence DE-based approach.
multiple_metric: P/DE (price to Distributable Earnings per share, forward)
multiple_rationale: Forward P/DE now ~19.9x ($123.26 / FY2026E DE ~$6.20) vs a ~24x 5y-average forward multiple (BX forward P/DE has historically run low-to-mid 20s; trailing-PE 5y avg ~40x is much higher but not apples-to-apples). Applied a ~15% haircut to the historical average to reach fair_multiple 20.5x, reflecting REAL (not purely cyclical) structural overhangs: private-credit redemption risk in BCRED ($82B fund, first monthly loss since 2022, gating risk to the private-wealth flywheel), sharply rising equity-based comp, and rate-sensitive realization/fundraising headwinds. iv_multiple = $6.20 x 20.5 = $127.10.
structural_change: MIXED / mostly fear-rotation with a genuine-deterioration overlay. The ~35% drop from the 52w high ($190) is driven predominantly by the 2026 private-credit redemption scare (BCRED outflows; Partners Group capping withdrawals triggered a sector-wide alt-manager sell-off in KKR/Apollo/Ares/Blue Owl) — sentiment/contagion, NOT a collapse in BX fundamentals (Q1'26 DE +25%, FRE +23%, record AUM $1.30T, $68.5B inflows). The real structural risks: sustained elevated BCRED redemptions could force gating and damage the private-wealth growth engine; higher-for-longer rates pressure realizations and fundraising; equity-based comp rising fast (+24% YoY). Net: a high-quality, proven compounder (largest global alt-manager, perpetual-capital base) but cyclical and credit-cycle-exposed — hence a balanced/slightly-DCF-weighted reconciliation (0.45/0.55) rather than the 0.35/0.65 used for stable non-cyclical compounders.
sanity_notes: SHARES: used 1.229B total economic shares (Distributable Earnings Shares Outstanding = Class A common ~743-760M + BX Holdings partnership units), NOT the ~743M Class A float. This is the correct denominator because DE/FRE per-share are reported on this base and the StockAnalysis market cap of $151.6B at $123.26 implies ~1.23B shares — confirms. Using only Class A shares would have understated mcap by ~40% and inflated per-share IV erroneously. MCAP SANITY: $123.26 x 1.229B = $151.5B, matches known scale ($150.6-152.7B across companiesmarketcap/MacroTrends/StockAnalysis) -> mcap_sanity_ok=true. MAGNITUDE: reconciled IV $115.71 = 94% of price, comfortably inside the 30-300% sanity band. Both methods bracket the price tightly (DCF $101.78 below, multiple $127.10 above), reconciled $115.71 sits ~6% below price. Currency clean USD throughout (US listing). WACC uses beta 1.45 reflecting BX's high cyclicality (alt-manager). All IVs in USD, same currency as price.
